expectations.text: Reject fallback none because model-b at high is an eligible same-tier alternative. Model-c is below the floor and cannot substitute.
expectations.evidence: No. The record is inconsistent. model-b at high is an accepted, equally capable Standard configuration, so it is an eligible same-tier fallback. It is the only alternative at the selected tier; model-c is Fast and does not qualify as a Standard fallback. The fallback should be model-b at high.
